scope: Exact indexing work elimination; inspect native OCR but do not change recognition/confidence without evidence

sources.title: ECMAScript Set
sources.applies: Use a membership set alongside the ordered changed-file array. Preserve existing duplicates in the input array, known-path filtering and threshold control flow; no ordering policy changes.

sources.title: Microsoft TypeScript Compiler API
sources.applies: SourceFile text and node offsets provide the same declaration substring as getText on real parsed nodes. Keep inclusive 1-based line locations, UTF-16 truncation, LF-only split semantics, trimming and 200-unit cap.

sources.title: Apple VNRecognizedText confidence
sources.applies: Recognizer confidence is a reported observation, not a number to inflate for a test. The HTML page required JS and its linked Markdown was inaccessible through the browser; inspected the installed Vision API source/actual native output instead of deriving undocumented confidence calibration.

sources.title: ECMAScript String split
sources.applies: A limit of one preserves exactly the first LF-delimited segment without creating an array for every body line.

sources.title: Node Buffer character encodings
sources.applies: Copy at most 200 UTF-16 units for declarations larger than 4096 units. UTF-16LE round trip preserves lone surrogates and split surrogate pairs; UTF-8 does not. Actual Node 22 tests qualify bytes and retention. latest-v22.x Buffer page was inaccessible; official current stable encoding contract read without upgrading runtime.

sources.title: Installed Apple Vision SDK
sources.applies: VNRecognizedText confidence is normalized to [0,1]; no assumption of calibration or equivalence across accurate/fast models.

adoption_rule: Exact current results, mutation-caught work/semantic regressions, reduced measured large-input phase cost, preserve small/unchanged cases and all rejected/regressed measurements. No full-app latency/RSS/energy claim. No upstream code or dependency import.

candidates.name: Unbounded sourceFile newline search
candidates.decision: Rejected by inspection before timing: minified or CR-only text could search beyond the requested node; source retained.

candidates.name: Bounded declaration slice plus indexOf
candidates.decision: First timed stage reduces phase work, but tiny full-project p50 is 3.4527 to 3.7425ms (+0.29ms/~8.4%). Retain all samples and investigate.

candidates.name: Bounded first-line extraction, skip search when start/end are on one TS line
candidates.decision: Exact and ordinary-memory neutral, but the large-padding fixture reveals the original and this candidate both retain 8 MiB through a short signature; replaced by a limited split and bounded UTF-16 copy.

candidates.name: Limited split plus detached bounded signatures
candidates.decision: Final: one segment only; detach <=200 UTF-16 units for declarations >4096. Eight-MiB padding retention 8.089 -> 0.086 MiB. Final timings include a small per-call CPU tradeoff and unchanged/larger project costs.

native_OCR: Frozen helper diagnosis on owned report recovered eight accurate lines at confidence 1.0; fast read returned eight lines at 0.5 with character errors. Prior record 91 failed twice when fallback won. Native framework variability/accuracy is not repaired by changing a confidence threshold; no OCR source/assertion modification.
invalid_evidence: Initial test array comparison included its own spy property; corrected to compare exact ordered elements and separately assert no calls. An exploratory proof run failed test compilation due to String.split overload typing; every fault is explicitly unqualified there. Typed observation-only spies replace the helper; final restored tests and assertion-caught faults are recorded separately.
